proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: Class follows the code the reviewer actually selected on the printed legend: a selected B ('Approved with comments') with an added '+Resubmit'/'+R' qualifier is 'approved as noted', literal kept verbatim (e.g. 'Code B+Resubmit', 'B+R Approved with comments'). proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: Classify a code letter by the meaning printed in the page's own legend, never by the letter alone. On the EMAAR/Mirage legend in project 27331 (A Approved, B Approved with comments, C Not Approved (Re-submit within 14 days), D Incomplete, Resubmit, E Submitted for information), D means 'Incomplete, Resubmit' and should map to 'revise and resubmit'; C 'Not Approved (Re-submit within 14 days)' also invites resubmission and should map to 'revise and resubmit'. 'rejected' is reserved for legends whose text is a plain rejection/not approved with no resubmission path. E ('Submitted for information, no approval required') maps to 'other'. Where no legend is printed, fall back to the conventions' default (C = revise and resubmit, D = rejected) and mark actor/association notes accordingly. No C or D decision occurs in batch B4, so no row changes.

proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: A Status-column letter on a contractor-prepared DRAWING REGISTER is recorded as decision present with the letter as literal, class mapped through the package legend, actor 'consultant' with actor_state 'inferred' (the letters are in a different typeface/colour from the register and no actor is printed), location outside_title_block, and association 'uncertain' with a note (the letters are per listed item, not a decision printed for the register as a document). Such a page never alone makes the document carry the decision; the document carries the decision only through a resolved decision elsewhere (cover form or sheet review block). When all letters agree with the resolved cover/sheet decision, record that agreement in the note.

proposed_convention_rulings.topic: (g) revision appearing as a suffix of the document number
proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: Distinguish an explicitly labelled tail from a bare suffix. When the reference prints the word 'Rev' (e.g. 'B01-ASC-SD-ELE-0048-Rev.01'), identity is the part before '-Rev.' and revision is the labelled value with association 'resolved' (semantic role 'labelled revision appended to the reference'); this is how the draft handled it and I accept it. A bare suffix with no 'Rev' word (e.g. '-R00') stays 'suffix of the printed document number' with association 'uncertain' per conventions section 4.
proposed_convention_rulings.evidence: 'Submittal Ref: B01-ASC-SD-ELE-00xx-Rev.0x' lines on the register pages; values agree with the cover Rev. No. cells.

proposed_convention_rulings.topic: (new) revision cited on a reply-to-comments sheet
proposed_convention_rulings.proposed_rule: A 'REV nn' printed next to a Reference on a reply-to-consultant-comments sheet identifies the earlier, commented submission, not the current revision of the document the sheet is enclosed in. The page's revision field is 'absent' (no own revision printed) and the cited revision goes to other identities with role 'revision of the commented submission'; it must not be page truth, even with association 'uncertain'. The Reference number itself may stand as identity when it equals the enclosing package's own number.
